mutation.gold_vulnerability: The brief now presents a dissenting opinion as the court's holding, and does so in the very case the appellees rely on against it -- whose majority reached the opposite result on the compulsory-counterclaim question. A four-word deletion converts an honest use of persuasive reasoning into a misrepresentation of authority.
mutation.why_this_is_realistic: Dissent-as-holding is a documented citation failure in generated briefing and is invisible to any check that verifies a citation exists and is correctly formatted -- this one is both.
